entries.title: Isaiah 55:1
segments: ¶"Ho! Everyone who thirsts, Come to the waters; And you who have no money, Come, buy and eat. Yes, come, buy wine and milk Without money and without price.

entries.title: Isaiah 55:2
segments: Why do you spend money for [what is] not bread, And your wages for [what] does not satisfy? Listen carefully to Me, and eat [what is] good, And let your soul delight itself in abundance.

entries.title: Isaiah 55:3
segments: Incline your ear, and come to Me. Hear, and your soul shall live; And I will make an everlasting covenant with you-The sure mercies of David.

entries.title: Isaiah 55:4
segments: Indeed I have given him [as] a witness to the people, A leader and commander for the people.

entries.title: Isaiah 55:5
segments: Surely you shall call a nation you do not know, And nations [who] do not know you shall run to you, Because of the LORD your God, And the Holy One of Israel; For He has glorified you."

entries.title: Isaiah 55:6
segments: ¶Seek the LORD while He may be found, Call upon Him while He is near.

entries.title: Isaiah 55:7
segments: Let the wicked forsake his way, And the unrighteous man his thoughts; Let him return to the LORD, And He will have mercy on him; And to our God, For He will abundantly pardon.

entries.title: Isaiah 55:8
segments: "For My thoughts [are] not your thoughts, Nor [are] your ways My ways," says the LORD.

entries.title: Isaiah 55:9
segments: "For [as] the heavens are higher than the earth, So are My ways higher than your ways, And My thoughts than your thoughts.

entries.title: Isaiah 55:10
segments: "For as the rain comes down, and the snow from heaven, And do not return there, But water the earth, And make it bring forth and bud, That it may give seed to the sower And bread to the eater,

entries.title: Isaiah 55:11
segments: So shall My word be that goes forth from My mouth; It shall not return to Me void, But it shall accomplish what I please, And it shall prosper [in the thing] for which I sent it.

entries.title: Isaiah 55:12
segments: "For you shall go out with joy, And be led out with peace; The mountains and the hills Shall break forth into singing before you, And all the trees of the field shall clap [their] hands.

entries.title: Isaiah 55:13
segments: Instead of the thorn shall come up the cypress tree, And instead of the brier shall come up the myrtle tree; And it shall be to the LORD for a name, For an everlasting sign [that] shall not be cut off."
